 36	 @Override
 37	 public long expireAfterCreate(Long key, Optional<User> value, long currentTime) {
 38	 return getNextExpiryNanos();
 39	 }

 42	 public long expireAfterUpdate(Long key, Optional<User> value, long currentTime, long currentDuration) {
 43	 return getNextExpiryNanos();

 48	 return currentDuration;

 53	 private long getNextExpiryNanos() {
 54	 LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
 55	 LocalDateTime nextExpiry = now.withHour(4).withMinute(0).withSecond(0).withNano(0);
 56	 if (now.compareTo(nextExpiry) >= 0) {
 57	 nextExpiry = nextExpiry.plusDays(1);
 58	 }
 59	 // 添加最多 5 分钟的随机偏移，避免缓存雪崩
 60	 long randomOffset = (long) (Math.random() * TimeUnit.MINUTES.toNanos(5));
 61	 return ChronoUnit.NANOS.between(now, nextExpiry) + randomOffset;
 62	 }

 64	 public User getUserById(Long id) {
 65	 try {
 66	 Optional<User> cacheIfPresent = cache.getIfPresent(id);
 67	 if (cacheIfPresent != null && cacheIfPresent.isPresent()) {
 68	 return cacheIfPresent.get();
 69	 }
 70	 logger.error("未获取到缓存数据:{}", id);
 71	 return null;
 72	 } catch (Exception e) {
 73	 logger.error("从缓存中获取数据异常", e);
 74	 return null;
 75	 }
 76	 }

 35	 .expireAfter(new Expiry<Long, Optional<User>>() {
 36	 @Override
 37	 public long expireAfterCreate(Long key, Optional<User> value, long currentTime) {
 38	 return getNextExpiryNanos();
 39	 }
 40	
 41	 @Override
 42	 public long expireAfterUpdate(Long key, Optional<User> value, long currentTime, long currentDuration) {
 43	 return getNextExpiryNanos();
 44	 }

 48	 return currentDuration;
 49	 }

 53	 private long getNextExpiryNanos() {
 54	 LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
 55	 LocalDateTime nextExpiry = now.withHour(4).withMinute(0).withSecond(0).withNano(0);
 56	 if (now.compareTo(nextExpiry) >= 0) {
 57	 nextExpiry = nextExpiry.plusDays(1);
 58	 }
 59	 // 添加最多 5 分钟的随机偏移，避免缓存雪崩
 60	 long randomOffset = (long) (Math.random() * TimeUnit.MINUTES.toNanos(5));
 61	 return ChronoUnit.NANOS.between(now, nextExpiry) + randomOffset;
 62	 }
 63	
 64	 public User getUserById(Long id) {
 65	 try {
 66	 Optional<User> cacheIfPresent = cache.getIfPresent(id);
 67	 if (cacheIfPresent != null && cacheIfPresent.isPresent()) {
 68	 return cacheIfPresent.get();
 69	 }
 70	 logger.error("未获取到缓存数据:{}", id);
 71	 return null;
 72	 } catch (Exception e) {
 73	 logger.error("从缓存中获取数据异常", e);
 74	 return null;
 75	 }
 76	 }
